text: Seabrook Town’s shift in momentum during the last 8 minutes (momentum index -0.556) is driven by sustained offensive pressure through five final third entries, exploiting their 3-4-3 wide crossing play formation to create wing overloads and crossing opportunities. Although their possession (46.4%) and pass accuracy (67.9%) lag behind Harbour City, Seabrook achieved a superior field tilt into the attacking third (52.0%), demonstrating effective penetration consistent with their crossing mechanism. Kian Romano’s two off-target shots—header and foot—exemplify Seabrook’s transition into aggressive wide attacks and delivery into the box from wide areas, leveraging wingbacks and the front three [#1744] [#1850]. Harbour City’s patient short passing in a 4-2-3-1 shape ensured superior possession (53.6%) and passing precision (78.1%) but lacked final third progression, allowing Seabrook’s targeted wide overloads and crosses to dictate play in this phase.
